modalities.evidence: Dynamic brain [18F]FDG-PET scans from two study sessions per participant

output.population: Fourteen healthy male participants who completed both imaging sessions in a within-subject crossover design; ages 25–43
output.summary: FDG-PET and structural MRI from a single-blind, placebo-controlled randomized crossover study of acute oromucosal DMT plus harmine effects on cerebral glucose metabolism in healthy volunteers, with BIDS derivatives and code.
